version.changelog:
- Provides an OOMOL-backed interface for operating fal.ai without handling raw API tokens.
- Documents the required `oo connector schema` and `oo connector run` workflow for all fal.ai actions.
- Supports fal model discovery, pricing lookup, cost estimation, queue submission, queue status streaming, and result retrieval.
- Includes queue cancellation and webhook JWKS retrieval capabilities.
- Defines safety guidance for read, write, and destructive actions, plus first-time setup troubleshooting.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@d4033b2`

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed fal.ai connector wrapper with limited local command access and clear user-confirmation rules for write actions.

dimensions.detail: Local tool authority is limited to Bash commands matching oo *, which is proportionate for a skill whose main function is calling the oo CLI connector.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill includes fallback first-time setup commands, including a remote installer, but instructs agents not to run setup proactively and only to use it after matching command/auth failures.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger text is broad for any fal.ai task, but the runtime instructions are scoped to the fal_ai connector and explicitly require user confirmation before write or destructive actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill uses an existing OOMOL account connection with server-side credential injection; this is disclosed and avoids exposing raw tokens, with no artifact evidence of hidden persistence or background execution.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to operate fal.ai through an OOMOL-connected account, and the documented actions all relate to fal.ai discovery, pricing, queue status/results, submission, or cancellation.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this only if you want your agent to use your OOMOL-connected fal.ai account. Review payloads before approving queue submissions or cancellations, because those can change fal.ai state or incur costs.
llm.findings: [SQP-1] expected: The broad fal.ai invocation language is supported by the skill's purpose as a fal.ai integration, and the artifact narrows execution through the fal_ai connector plus user confirmation for write/destructive actions, so this remains guidance rather than a Review-level concern.
